turns.user: I have a monthly pass for job seekers. Can I get the airport bus add-on?
turns.agent:
No. The 1,000 HUF 100E add-on is not available with the monthly pass for job seekers. If you’re taking 100E, the snapshot lists its full-price ticket at 2,500 HUF; that ticket covers one 100E trip, not transfers or another city route. Bus 200E follows ordinary ticket/pass rules instead.

These details come from the 5 November 2026 snapshot of selected BKK information, not a live check. The current rules are on BKK’s add-on ticket page and airport express page. I can’t sell or issue a ticket; this is an independent educational demo, not affiliated with BKK.
turns.turn_assessment: Correctly denies job-seeker monthly-pass eligibility for the add-on and offers an alternative under the dated model.
